title.notes: Each event detail page's own <title> tag, e.g. 'Airbag | Palau Sant Jordi'.

start_date.notes: Each event detail page's own literal 'let startDate = "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS";' JavaScript assignment — present verbatim in the static server-rendered HTML (a client framework later reads this value to populate real JSON-LD at runtime, but the value itself needs no JS execution to read).

time.notes: Time-of-day portion of the same startDate value.

end.notes: Each event detail page's own literal 'endDate' assignment, when present.

venue_location.notes: Each event detail page's own literal 'address' assignment discriminates which of the complex's three halls (Palau Sant Jordi arena, Estadi Olímpic, or Sant Jordi Club) the event belongs to — this package's collector retains ONLY records whose address is the exact string 'Sant Jordi Club', discarding the others.
